label: Use the other diagonal
helper: Keep the shortest-gap midpoint and distance; put the nearest bird down and left on a 45-degree diagonal. Both flights stay unchanged.
output: place-other-diagonal changes two places without changing their flights

label: Put the pair side by side
helper: Keep the shortest-gap midpoint and distance; put the nearest bird to the right. Both flights stay unchanged.
output: place-level changes two places without changing their flights

label: Stack the pair’s places
helper: Keep the shortest-gap midpoint and distance; put the nearest bird below. Both flights stay unchanged.
output: place-upright changes two places without changing their flights

label: Halve the pair’s height gap
helper: Halve only the shortest vertical gap around the shared midpoint. Keep the horizontal gap and both flights.
output: place-flatten changes two places without changing their flights

label: Halve the pair’s width gap
helper: Halve only the shortest horizontal gap around the shared midpoint. Keep the vertical gap and both flights.
output: place-narrow changes two places without changing their flights

label: Put the pair on a diagonal
helper: Keep the shortest-gap midpoint and distance; put the nearest bird down and right on a 45-degree diagonal. Both flights stay unchanged.
output: place-diagonal changes two places without changing their flights

label: Flip the pair top to bottom
helper: Reverse only the shortest vertical gap around the shared midpoint. Keep the horizontal gap and both flights.
output: place-flip-height changes two places without changing their flights
